---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to Kingfisher
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What chess workflow are you trying to improve?

One or two sentences. "I want to find every Sicilian where
Black played … on move 6" is a workflow. "Add dark mode" is a
preference.

## What currently happens?

What you do today, in the application or elsewhere, to do this.

## What would improve it?

What Kingfisher would need to do. A rough sketch of the UI is
welcome; ASCII is fine.

## Anything else?

Sources, references, related discussions. If this is a thing
another chess tool already does well, name it. We are not above
borrowing a good idea.
